## YTD Studio 1.2.0: your own YouTube algorithm, powered by Ollama

**Which file do I need?**

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `…-1.2.0-setup.exe` | Windows installer |
| `YTD-Studio-1.2.0-arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Practically every Android phone. **Use this one.** |
| `YTD-Studio-1.2.0-armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Old 32-bit Android phones |
| `YTD-Studio-1.2.0-x86_64-release.apk` | Android emulator / Chromebooks |

### New: AI features (both apps, optional)
Connect **Ollama Cloud** (paste your API key) or your own Ollama server in **Settings > AI (Ollama)**, pick a model, and you get:

- **Discover**: describe what you want to watch in plain words, or tap **For you**. The model plans several YouTube searches (with YouTube's own date, length and sort filters), the app runs them, and the model ranks every result for *you*, with a match score and a one-line reason for each pick. Shorts, live streams, hidden channels and videos you already have are left out.
  - **Refine** in plain words ("shorter", "for beginners"), undo, or load **More** without repeats.
  - **Thumbs up / down** and **Never show this channel** are remembered and shape every later ranking.
  - Play, summarize or download (one or all) right from the results.
- **AI insights**: a *TL;DW* summary of any video from its captions, with **key moments you can tap to jump there**, plus questions and answers about the video. On Windows it sits under the Stream player; on Android, tap the sparkle button in the player.
- **Smart playlists**: the model sorts your library into themed playlists; you choose which ones to create.

Your API key is stored encrypted (Windows: OS keychain; Android: Android Keystore) and is only sent to your AI server and to Ollama web search. Nothing is sent anywhere until you use an AI feature.

> Android: if your previous APK was signed with a different key (see the README), uninstall it before installing this one.
